caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object, centrally positioned on an otherwise blank or lightly shaded background. The object appears to be a pair of tongs or sugar nips, composed of two elongated handles that curve slightly outward and end in large, scallop shell-like gripping ends. The body of the object is rendered in shades of grey, suggesting a metallic, possibly silver, material. Decorative details are visible on one side, including an urn-shaped motif surrounded by ornate floral or leafy embellishments. Near the scallop-ended grips, the joins show a clear separation, indicating the two handles function as a hinged tool. There is a faint shadow below the object, reinforcing its three-dimensional form. In the lower left corner of the drawing, a small signature or inscription is present, written in stylized, capitalized text. The background is an even off-white, with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Silver Sugar Tongs
